subject: Crushed bundles on SO-20811
body: Two bundles of the 12x12x12 boxes on SO-20811 came in crushed yesterday.
Please ship two replacement bundles with our next delivery or sooner if you can.

truth.handling: The delivery notes 2 damaged bundles, so reship 2 at no charge. $58.00 is well under the reship cap.
